description: This Kotlin source file defines the 'NodeApp' class, which extends the Android 'Application' class. It manages the application's runtime environment, including lazy initialization of 'NodeRuntime' and setup of strict mode policies in debug builds.

classes.name: NodeApp
classes.description: An Android application class that manages runtime setup and strict mode configuration for debugging purposes.

methods.name: ensureRuntime
methods.description: Ensures that a singleton instance of 'NodeRuntime' exists, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: peekRuntime
methods.description: Returns the current 'NodeRuntime' instance if available, or null.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the application, setting strict mode policies if the build is in debug mode.
